name: Daikin AC WiFi (S403)
summary: Control the Daikin MTKL50UV16VA AC over WiFi via its S403 service port (S21 protocol) using an ESP32-C3 Super Mini and a galvanically isolated interface. The previous Orient Zeno IR fan-blaster has been removed.
safety: S403 port is NON-isolated — GND sits at mains potential and pin 10 is approximately 320V DC. The ADuM1201 isolation barrier is mandatory.
Bench-test the harness voltages BEFORE connecting to the AC: pin1<->6 ~14V, pin4<->6 ~5V, pin5<->6 ~5V.
All work with the AC unplugged/de-energized except controlled voltage verification by a competent person. Pin 10 must remain empty and insulated.
